# Template Sources

This folder stores copied/downloaded source templates used to structure V2
project documents. Sources were checked against GitHub stars on 2026-05-24.

## Primary Star-Rated Sources

- GitHub Spec Kit (`github/spec-kit`, 105,380 stars): primary source for specs,
  plans, tasks, and implementation checklists.
- arc42 Template (`arc42/arc42-template`, 1,218 stars): primary source for
  technical architecture, TRD, and backend design structure.
- MADR (`adr/madr`, 2,218 stars): primary source for architecture decision
  records when V2 design choices need traceability.
- Best README Template (`othneildrew/Best-README-Template`, 16,081 stars):
  optional source for repo packaging and public-facing README structure.

## Local Repo-Ready Templates

- `spec-kit-spec-template.md` copied from `.specify/templates/spec-template.md`
- `spec-kit-plan-template.md` copied from `.specify/templates/plan-template.md`
- `spec-kit-tasks-template.md` copied from `.specify/templates/tasks-template.md`
- `spec-kit-checklist-template.md` copied from `.specify/templates/checklist-template.md`

These are the installed Spec Kit templates already present in this repository.

## Secondary Reference

- `opulo-prd-template.md`
- `opulo-prd-template-LICENSE.md`

Downloaded from `opulo-inc/prd-template` on GitHub. It has only 25 stars as
of the 2026-05-24 check, so it should not be treated as a top-starred source.
Keep it only as a PRD wording reference, preserve CC BY-SA 4.0 attribution,
and prefer Spec Kit for the canonical V2 requirements structure.
